address.description: Recorded service-instance address, when available. Preserve its source form without inventing a hostname or URL.

created.description: Recorded creation time of this container on the source platform. This is distinct from observation first_seen and last_seen.

id.description: Identifier assigned to this container by the source platform. Preserve it as text; it is scoped to its service instance and parent container.

kind.description: Container kind. When absent, interpret this object as a chat. A subchannel or thread must specify its kind.

language.description: Language observed in messages belonging to this container, expressed as a language code.

name.description: Recorded display name of this chat, subchannel or thread.

network.description: Logical network or deployment name recorded for the service instance. This is not restricted to transport networks such as Tor or I2P.

protocol.description: Messaging service or protocol, such as rocket-chat, telegram, matrix or discord. Together with network and address, identifies the service instance.

url.description: Direct URL of this container on the source service, when known. Do not substitute a collector user-interface URL.

username.description: Platform username assigned to this container, if any. This is not a participant username.

description: A chat, subchannel or discussion thread on a messaging service, including its platform identifier, name, username, description and service context.
name: chat
